extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and the Chrome Web Store. 75 characters at most.

extShortName.description: Short extension name. 12 characters at most.

extDescription.message: Attach clipboard screenshots to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Doubao, or Grok in one step. Never sends messages for you.
extDescription.description: Extension summary shown in Chrome and the Chrome Web Store. 132 characters at most.

localeTag.description: BCP 47 language tag of this translation, used for the HTML lang attribute.

optionsDocumentTitle.description: Browser tab title of the settings page.

commandAttachDefault.message: Attach clipboard screenshot to the default AI

targetChatgpt.description: Display name of the ChatGPT target.

targetClaude.description: Display name of the Claude target.

targetGemini.description: Display name of the Gemini target.

targetDoubao.description: Display name of the Doubao target.

targetGrok.description: Display name of the Grok target.

noClipboardImage.message: No image on the clipboard. Take a screenshot first, then try again.
noClipboardImage.description: Shown when the clipboard holds no image.

attachSuccess.message: Screenshot attached. Type your question and send it yourself.
attachSuccess.description: Shown after an attachment is confirmed.

attachUnconfirmed.message: The attach action ran, but the result could not be confirmed. Check the input box first; paste with Ctrl+V / Cmd+V only if no image is there.
attachUnconfirmed.description: Shown when the page may already hold the screenshot.

attachFallback.message: Automatic attach failed. The screenshot is still on the clipboard; paste it with Ctrl+V / Cmd+V.
attachFallback.description: Shown when attaching failed and the screenshot was put back on the clipboard.

attachFallbackNoWrite.message: Automatic attach failed. Paste the screenshot with Ctrl+V / Cmd+V.
attachFallbackNoWrite.description: Shown when attaching failed and writing back to the clipboard is turned off.

attachFallbackWriteFailed.message: Automatic attach failed. Paste with Ctrl+V / Cmd+V. Putting the screenshot back on the clipboard failed, but the clipboard usually still holds it.
attachFallbackWriteFailed.description: Shown when attaching failed and writing the screenshot back to the clipboard also failed.

targetLoadFailed.message: The AI page failed to load. Open the page and try again.
targetLoadFailed.description: Shown when the target page does not load.

serviceUnavailable.message: The extension's background service is unavailable. Try again in a moment.
serviceUnavailable.description: Shown when the service worker does not respond.

autoMonitorRecovering.message: Automatic mode is recovering. Please wait a moment.
autoMonitorRecovering.description: Automatic mode status while it restarts.

autoMonitorUnavailable.message: Automatic mode is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
autoMonitorUnavailable.description: Automatic mode status when supported pages cannot be listed.

autoMonitorWaiting.message: Automatic mode is on and waits for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Doubao, or Grok to be open.
autoMonitorWaiting.description: Automatic mode status when no supported page is open.

autoMonitorRunning.description: Automatic mode status while it watches the clipboard.

autoMonitorStartFailed.description: Automatic mode status when the clipboard monitor fails to start.

errorNoPermission.message: Can't read the clipboard. Make sure the browser lets this extension access the clipboard.

errorUnsupportedImage.message: The clipboard has no usable PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.

errorClipboardRead.message: Reading the clipboard failed. Take a new screenshot and try again.

errorClipboardWrite.message: Putting the screenshot back on the clipboard failed. Take a new screenshot and paste it yourself.

errorTargetTab.message: Couldn't open or switch to the AI page.

errorTargetNotReady.message: The AI input box isn't ready yet.

errorAdapterNotFound.message: Attaching isn't supported on this AI page yet.
errorAdapterNotFound.description: No adapter for the page error.

errorScriptInjection.message: Couldn't load the attach script into the AI page.

errorUnknown.message: Something went wrong. Try again later.

popupIntro.message: The screenshot goes into the AI input box. You still decide when to send.

popupDefaultTarget.description: Popup label for the default target.

popupLoadFailed.description: Popup placeholder when settings fail to load.

popupAutoHint.message: Turn on automatic paste in Settings
popupAutoHint.description: Popup hint when automatic mode status is unknown.

popupDefaultLoadFailed.description: Primary button text when settings fail to load.

popupDefaultLoading.description: Primary button text while settings load.

popupQuickTargets.description: Accessible label of the target button group.

popupLastResult.description: Popup label for the latest operation.

triggerAuto.description: How the latest operation was triggered.

triggerManual.description: How the latest operation was triggered.

popupHelpLinks.description: Accessible label of the popup footer links.

optionsIntro.message: Manual mode runs only when you trigger it. Automatic mode is off by default; when on, it looks for new screenshots only while a supported AI page is open.

optionsStep1.message: 1. Copy a screenshot to the clipboard with your system screenshot tool.

optionsStep2.message: 2. Click a button in the toolbar popup, or press a shortcut, to attach it to an AI page.

optionsStep3.message: 3. Check the attachment and your prompt, then send the message yourself.

optionShowToast.message: Show a page notification after success or failure

optionWriteBack.message: Put the screenshot back on the clipboard if attaching fails

optionOpenInNewTab.message: Open the AI page in a new tab if it isn't open

optionsPrivacyNoHistory.message: The extension never reads chat history, never keeps a screenshot history, and never sends messages for you.

optionsPrivacyClipboard.message: Clipboard access reads your screenshot, prepares the captured image for a manual Gemini or Doubao paste, and puts it back after a failed attach.

optionsPrivacySites.message: Site access covers only ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Doubao, and Grok.

optionsSaveFailed.message: Couldn't save the setting. Try again.
